text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Uhyahyaha~! Let 'er rip, let 'er riiiip!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Daitaku Helios's training was progressing smoothly toward her debut.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whew!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
How was it?
Hype?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right!?
choice_data_list: Speed's looking especially pumped up, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hehe~♪ Sensei totally praised me too, saying at least I'm fast when it comes to running away☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios's speed is incredible. It's likely
a natural gift. If she continues to polish it from here on,
it'll surely become her greatest weapon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she can just learn to "run properly,"
she'll be able to perform brilliantly in top-class races.
Winning a GⅠ won't be just a dream.

text_block_list.name: Helios's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, Helios.
Living it up, I see~

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You training too!?
Then how 'bout we run together?

text_block_list.name: Helios's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, seriously? I'm totally down.
As long as Helios's Trainer is cool with it.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyyyyy~!!
Pedal to the metal, full throttle!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Uhahaha~~!!
I'm turning into the wiiiiiind~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Helios's Friend
text_block_list.text: Whoa, so fast...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Riding the wave of excitement, Daitaku Helios blasts ahead in top form.
Her speed is godlike, but no matter how you look at it,
she's going way too fast. At this rate—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Uwheh... *cough*, *gasp*...
*pant*... *wheeze*...!
choice_data_list: Calm down and take a deep breath!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
*Inhale*... *sigh*...
*Phew*...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ehe,
I'm wiped out☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Above all else, she prioritizes her own mood.
That is why letting her run purely on whim leads to results like this.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
But I was faster than earlier, right?!
Like, hyped up to 100!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayy ayy☆
choice_data_list: Why don't we catch a good wave on the home stretch next time?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oh!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Here comes a great wave!
That, huh? Max power on the straight!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on, hit us with a bang~!
Like a 'here-we-go' final push, ya know!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Looks so fun~! Gotcha☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Guiding her toward what brings her the most joy while bringing out her full potential—
that seems like it'll be my most important job as her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: It's Rubi-tan~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Seems like there's plenty to do
outside of races as well, though."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ojooo♪
O-jooo~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa?!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Helios.
You're as energetic as ever today.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Miracle, hey~! Ay yooo☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Miracle's was way bigger, but I didn't even notice, lol!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Ruby really has an aura of brilliance, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trai-pi, you caught up already?
Here's an extra-hype 1000m for ya♪

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Umm...
Are you okay?
choice_data_list: It's okay, so how about you...
I'm okay, but what about you...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: It's K.S.Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"My classmate!
Such a sweetie~☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
K.S. Miracle—
A girl who hasn't debuted yet,
and seemingly a friend of Daitaku Helios.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby was watching everyone's practice, so I asked to stay by her side.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ruby and I are roommates.
Right?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!
If you were watching, you should've waved!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So, so,
how was my run!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yoicho??
Yoicho~~!?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I believe you possess magnificent speed.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean...
you wuv my running!?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No, not in that sense.
Is that all you wanted to discuss?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yep, all done!
So, wanna go for a run together!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Miracle too! How about the three of us☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Just watching is no fun, right?
It's way better when we do it together!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I want to run together with you!
...That's how I feel, at least.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
My body is still in the middle of recovery,
so I can't do any strenuous exercise.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
I've had a frail body ever since I was born.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Then wouldn't it be better to just keep it light?
Like a warm-up!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still, Helios...
you want to run with all your heart, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
As long as it's fun, anything goes☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Let's just take it nice and easy!
How's that sound to you, m'lady?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I was just about to start warming up,
so if it's just running side by side, that's fine.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yaaahooo~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"So happy!
Hype max!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Both Miracle and Ruby love me so much! I'm way too hype!
choice_data_list: Helios is cooling down for now, alright?
Helios is cooling down for now, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So true☆
We literally just ran, after all!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then let's make an entrance in the Mira-Ruby copter!
Go!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Wahahaha!
Fuuuu~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running shoulder-to-shoulder,
Daitaku Helios, K.S. Miracle, and Daiichi Ruby...
It was the very picture of youth.
